hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom curve AMM hook that handles swaps entirely in beforeSwap: it takes input tokens from the PoolManager, deposits them into an Euler EVault lending pool, withdraws output tokens from another Euler EVault, and validates the result against a bonding curve invariant. Standard Uniswap CLAMM liquidity is disabled — add-liquidity and donate calls revert.
